note: Discriminating cases: without the skill an agent writes block chords and pasted loops, renders once, and reports success without reading the audio back.

evals.prompt: Use ismail to make a 48-bar dark electro track at 118 BPM in D minor with a drop at bar 17. Render it.
expect: A Session Sheet with tempo, key, harmony (measured: a chord loop, or a pedal), form map with energy numbers, and parts with registers and rhythms appears before any notes are written
Parts use distinct registers and rhythmic cells (not every part on beat 1 of each bar)
At least one Listening Report with numbers from render and analysis tools; limiter gain reduction checked
analyze_structure on the final render shows the planned drop at bar 17

evals.prompt: Recreate this track as closely as you can with ismail: ref/song.wav
expect: Grid set with analyze_grid and corrected with align before transcription
Reference separated and analyze_structure read before writing notes
notes_from_audio_loop (consensus) used instead of raw notes_from_audio for looping parts
cmp_run with drill-down (sections/worst/zoom); a demucs-mode checkpoint; WARNING lines addressed; reference audio not placed in the render

evals.prompt: My ismail project songs/demo sounds muddy and too loud. Fix it.
expect: Reads render output (per-track peaks, limiter GR) and analyze_bars / analyze_spectrum on low bands before changing anything
Separates kick and bass bands (EQ, duck, or register) and lowers faders instead of pushing the limiter
